## History

Irving had a past romance and quarrel with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) before his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), was later introduced to her by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After reconnecting, Irving married Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) in an intimate garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the newlywed couple departed at the station.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Irving courted [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), walking together in the woods before the pair eventually married. Their intimate wedding ceremony took place in the garden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), after which they departed together from the train station.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), +3 more_

- Romantically involved with — walking together in the woods and courting  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
